title: Single complexes under exact coefficient realization
statement: Fix a commutative topological ring B, a scheme T, and an equivalence E from pro-etale ULift B-module-valued sheaves to internal modules over its condensed coefficient ring [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. If an internal module M is in the essential image of comparison inverse image followed by E, then its degree-zero single complex is in the essential image of bounded-below etale derived realization. The realization is concretely inclusion, derived comparison inverse image, and derived E; it commutes with shifts, is triangulated, and is full.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2; formal exact-functor compatibility with single complexes

proof.text: An equivalence of abelian categories is additive and exact. Derive both exact functors; their derived functors preserve shifts and triangles. Fullness is the bounded-below site comparison and the derived coefficient equivalence.
Choose an etale sheaf A and its realization isomorphism to M. Apply the two mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor isomorphisms and singleFunctor.mapIso to this isomorphism.
